entities.summary: Wu Chuo-liu, born Wu Jiantian (吳建田) was an influential Taiwanese journalist and novelist of Hakka ancestry. He has been described as the most powerful witness to history in Taiwanese letters. Many of his most important novels were first written in Japanese.
